# PCAT brand assets

`pcat_icon`, `pcat_logo`, `pcat_banner`, and `pcat_social_preview` are size and layout exports of one mark. The mark is a Harvard Crimson circle with a black outline, a prominent `PCAT` wordmark, and white dot, line, square, and cube glyphs for 0D through 3D parameter spaces. Compact black two-way arrows between glyphs represent transdimensional moves. The wordmark and glyphs are separated and remain inside the circular field. There are no alternate logo concepts.

Run `python docs/make_logo.py` from the repository root to regenerate the assets.
